rows.name: Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Nevada's physicians and physician assistants. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — six practicing physicians, a physician assistant, and public members (NRS 630.050).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Nevada Revised Statutes; NV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nevada State Board of Nursing
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Nevada's nurses. Seven members appointed by the Governor — four registered nurses, one practical nurse, one nursing assistant, and one consumer member (NRS 632.020).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Nevada Revised Statutes; NV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nevada Board of Wildlife Commissioners
rows.mandate: Sets wildlife policy and regulations for the Nevada Department of Wildlife. Nine members appointed by the Governor representing conservation, farming, ranching, sportsmen, and the general public (NRS 501.171).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Nevada Revised Statutes; NV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nevada Real Estate Commission
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Nevada's real estate brokers and salespersons. Five members appointed by the Governor, with regional residency requirements across the state (NRS 645.050).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Nevada Revised Statutes; NV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Nevada Gaming Commission
rows.mandate: Final authority on gaming licensing and policy for Nevada's casino industry. Five members appointed by the Governor to four-year part-time terms (NRS 463.022).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from Nevada Revised Statutes; NV publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
